text_koine: ἡ Κοάλα καὶ ὁ Δεινόσαυρος παίζουσιν ἔξω παρὰ τὴν οἰκίαν. χαίρουσιν.
text_english: Koala and Dinosaur play outside beside the house. They are happy.
objects: A low wooden fence made of three pale-brown rails and short posts, with smooth rounded tops.
positioning: Koala stands at the left side of the front garden near the low fence, facing right with paws lifted in play.
Dinosaur stands at the right side of the garden near the cobblestone path, facing left with a cheerful stance.
A low wooden fence made of three pale-brown rails and short posts, with smooth rounded tops runs along the back of the garden behind Koala and Dinosaur, with a corner post near Koala.

text_koine: ἡ Κοάλα ἔχει ἄνθος. ὁ Δεινόσαυρος ἔχει σφαῖραν.
text_english: Koala has a flower. Dinosaur has a ball.
objects: A yellow five-petal flower with a long green stem.
A bright red ball with a thin white seam.
positioning: Koala stands left of center holding the flower upright at chest height in her left paw.
Dinosaur stands right of center holding the ball at waist height with both hands.
A yellow five-petal flower with a long green stem is held in Koala’s left paw, petals facing upward.
A bright red ball with a thin white seam is cradled in Dinosaur’s hands at the right side of the frame.

objects: A low wooden fence made of three pale-brown rails and short posts, with smooth rounded tops.
positioning: Korax perches on a low fence post at center-left, facing into the yard with wings slightly open and head tilted.
A low wooden fence made of three pale-brown rails and short posts, with smooth rounded tops lines the left edge of the yard, with the top rail just below Korax’s feet.

text_koine: ὁ Κόραξ βλέπει τὸ ἄνθος καὶ τὴν σφαῖραν.
text_english: Korax sees the flower and the ball.
objects: A yellow five-petal flower with a long green stem.
A bright red ball with a thin white seam.
positioning: Korax stands on a low perch in the midground watching intently toward the children.
Koala is at the left holding the flower close to her chest, looking toward Korax.
Dinosaur is at the right holding the ball, turning slightly toward Korax.
A yellow five-petal flower with a long green stem is in Koala’s paw at the left side.
A bright red ball with a thin white seam is in Dinosaur’s hands at the right side.
Korax strides low along the cobblestone path from right toward center, wings half-open and beak forward.

text_koine: ὁ Κόραξ κλέπτει τὸ ἄνθος τῆς Κοάλης καὶ φεύγει.
text_english: Korax steals Koala's flower and flees.
objects: A yellow five-petal flower with a long green stem.
positioning: Korax is at center grabbing toward the left with his beak angled away to flee.
Koala stands at the left reaching forward with a surprised face and emptying paw.
A yellow five-petal flower with a long green stem is clamped at the tip of Korax’s beak, pulled away from Koala.

text_koine: ἡ Κοάλα ὀργίζεται καὶ διώκει τὸν Κόρακα.
text_english: Koala gets angry and chases Korax.
positioning: Koala runs from left toward right along the garden path with arms outstretched.
Korax flees ahead of Koala toward the right edge, low over the path with wings tucked.

text_koine: ὁ Κόραξ κλέπτει τὴν σφαῖραν τοῦ Δεινοσαύρου καὶ φεύγει.
text_english: Korax steals Dinosaur's ball and flees.
objects: A bright red ball with a thin white seam.
positioning: Korax is at center-right snatching and turning away with quick motion.
Dinosaur stands at the right reaching forward in surprise as his hands empty.
A bright red ball with a thin white seam is pinched under Korax’s beak and lifted from Dinosaur’s hands.

text_koine: ὁ Δεινόσαυρος ὀργίζεται καὶ διώκει τὸν Κόρακα.
text_english: Dinosaur gets angry and chases Korax.
positioning: Dinosaur runs from right toward center along the path with determined eyes.
Korax flees ahead at low height toward the center-left, wings beating quickly.

text_koine: ἰδού ἡ Γλαῦξ ἀναγινώσκει βιβλίον παρὰ τὸ δένδρον.
text_english: Behold Owl reads a book beside the tree.
objects: A blue-covered book with a plain cover.
A broad old tree with rough gray-brown bark and thick roots, trunk as wide as a small table.
A short chopped stump with ring lines, warm brown top and mossy green edges.
positioning: Owl perches on a low stump at the base of the broad tree on the left, head bowed to read.
A blue-covered book with a plain cover lies open on Owl’s lap near the tree roots.
A broad old tree with rough gray-brown bark and thick roots, trunk as wide as a small table stands on the left, its roots spreading toward the stump.
A short chopped stump with ring lines, warm brown top and mossy green edges sits in the foreground left where Owl balances.

text_koine: ὁ Κόραξ βλέπει τὸ βιβλίον καὶ ἔρχεται.
text_english: Korax sees the book and comes.
objects: A blue-covered book with a plain cover.
A short chopped stump with ring lines, warm brown top and mossy green edges.
positioning: Korax approaches low from the right along the path toward the tree, head tilted at the book.
Owl remains at the base of the tree on the left, holding steady and looking up.
A blue-covered book with a plain cover rests open near Owl’s talons at the tree roots.
A broad old tree with rough gray-brown bark and thick roots, trunk as wide as a small table fills the left side, roots curving toward center.
A short chopped stump with ring lines, warm brown top and mossy green edges is just before Owl, slightly right of the trunk.

text_koine: ὁ Κόραξ κλέπτει τὸ βιβλίον καὶ φεύγει.
text_english: Korax steals the book and flees.
objects: A blue-covered book with a plain cover.
positioning: Korax darts across the trunk area from right to left with the book gripped in his beak.
Owl leans forward from the tree base reaching out after him.
A blue-covered book with a plain cover is clamped in Korax’s beak as he bolts away.
A broad old tree with rough gray-brown bark and thick roots, trunk as wide as a small table stands behind Owl, its roots framing the chase.

text_koine: ἀλλὰ τύπτει εἰς τὸ δένδρον καὶ πίπτει.
text_english: But he strikes into the tree and falls.
objects: A blue-covered book with a plain cover.
positioning: Korax collides with the sturdy tree trunk at center-left, wings splayed as he tumbles downward.
A blue-covered book with a plain cover slips from his beak and falls by the tree roots.
A broad old tree with rough gray-brown bark and thick roots, trunk as wide as a small table dominates the left, its trunk the point of impact.

objects: A blue-covered book with a plain cover.
positioning: Owl stands at the base of the tree calmly bending to pick up the book.
A blue-covered book with a plain cover rests by the roots within Owl’s reach.
A broad old tree with rough gray-brown bark and thick roots, trunk as wide as a small table frames the left side, roots curling around the book.

text_koine: ἡ Κοάλα καὶ ὁ Δεινόσαυρος λαμβάνουσιν τὸ ἄνθος καὶ τὴν σφαῖραν καὶ φεύγουσιν.
text_english: Koala and Dinosaur take the flower and the ball and flee.
objects: A yellow five-petal flower with a long green stem.
A bright red ball with a thin white seam.
positioning: Koala hurries from center toward the cottage door at left, holding the flower up in front.
Dinosaur trots beside her toward the door, clutching the ball close to his belly.
A yellow five-petal flower with a long green stem is held upright in Koala’s paw as they move left.
A bright red ball with a thin white seam is tucked in Dinosaur’s arms as they move left.
Korax moves away along the garden path toward the right background with head low and wings drooping.
